title: A background land closes its window once land's own checkout holds the done commit, though the landing may still fail
goal: Found in the SP-wgx4pq4r review of BG-cwoyc7yh: backlog.py land rebases work/<id> and runs done --commit in the orchestrator's own checkout (bl_land.land_once) before the heavy checks, sync --push and verify_landed; a later hook of a session that launched land in the background runs ql_capture.settle_pending, which reads the item file there as done and writes the done row; if the checks or sync then fail, land switches back to the start branch (the file says doing again) but the done row stays, so a failed landing still closes the window. settle_pending writes the deferred done row only once the landing has pushed (not while the checkout is on the item's work/<id> branch mid-land), the repro exits 0, and querylog.md and usage.md say so.

run: import os,sys,json,tempfile;from pathlib import Path;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=str(t/'d');os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT']=str(Path.cwd());sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture as q;co=t/'co';(co/'.git').mkdir(parents=True);(co/'.git'/'HEAD').write_text('ref: refs/heads/work/ST-aaaaaaaa\n');f=co/'kb'/'_self'/'backlog'/'ST-aaaaaaaa.json';f.parent.mkdir(parents=True);f.write_text(json.dumps({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','status':'done'}));q.record('prompt','s1',prompt_id='p1',prompt='x');q.record('work','s1',prompt_id='p1',action='done-pending',item='ST-aaaaaaaa');r=q.settle_pending(Path(q.spool_dir()),'s1',{'cwd':str(co)},'p2');print('done rows while land holds the work branch checked out:',r);sys.exit(1 if r else 0)

notes: Merged from BG-p7bp24ee “A background landing that pushed never closes its window when land left the session's checkout un-fast-forwarded” at the 2026-10-10 backlog triage: Repro still exits 1 (no done row when done is only on origin/main), but it is the other side of BG-45zpw2go in the same function: settle_pending should read done from origin/main, not the checkout file. Its goal: Found in the SP-wgx4pq4r review of BG-cwoyc7yh: ql_capture.settle_pending reads only the item file in the checkout at the event's cwd, which holds the done status only when bl_land.fast_forward_start moved it; a checkout that is detached, on a branch whose upstream is not origin/main, dirty, or diverged keeps the file at doing, so the done-pending row never settles and every later prompt of the session counts on the item's window. settle_pending also settles a pending item whose done status is on the integration main (origin/main) though the checkout lags, the repro exits 0, and querylog.md and usage.md say so. Its touches: _tools/ql_capture.py, kb/_self/querylog.md, kb/_self/usage.md, kb/_self/code.md Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 5 of 13, "Headless sprint loop 2: intake drafts, land windows and worker cost"); it blocks no fitness test and no real user reported it, so it sits in a late sprint of the sequence.
